bridge_entry.CLI: fixed bridge entry --config <canonical path> --config-sha256 <64hex>; one bounded request/response

context_rights.checkpoint: null for initial; FileBinding {path,sha256,bytes,mtime_ns_max} for continuation

checkpoint.next_context_id: matches continuation controller_context_id, different from initial
checkpoint.verified_dev_run_ids: exact two distinct native UUIDs, rechecked against actual bound eligible dev results
checkpoint.research_sha256: opened current nonempty research.md hash at first continuation admission
checkpoint.prior_process_receipt: FileBinding of actual root-owned terminal process receipt
checkpoint.prior_session: FileBinding of actual completed native session JSONL
checkpoint.prior_session_id: native UUID matching header and filename
checkpoint.campaign_used_tokens: rederived all-four-category usage from bound prior session, not a supplied grant

proof_requirements: Do not accept terminated=true or combined_usage_known=true as evidence. Open both bound evidence files with existing bounded nofollow reader.

Process receipt: expected A2 schema, status=succeeded, returncode=0, handle exists, root_process_reaped and confirmed_for_tracked_processes true, alive_tracked_after_cleanup empty, observer/census/cleanup errors empty. This is observed-only termination evidence, not hostile whole-tree isolation.

Prior native session lies under process handle.session_dir; header ID/cwd/provider/model match checkpoint. Parse with campaign_usage; complete=true and all four categories sum to checkpoint campaign_used_tokens below120000.
Checkpoint itself is root-created after actual process termination and externally hash-bound by deployment. It is never model-written or a native gate self-attestation.

Recheck exactly two eligible dev UUIDs and research bytes before admitting continuation context. Record one durable context admission so later normal research.md edits do not invalidate already-verified handoff.

rights.initial: No final_refit and no new R1 once two valid dev results exist. At most one frozen known pre-first-metric repair. Campaign fences persist.
rights.continuation: At most remaining one dev opportunity and one final refit. No reset of attempt/usage counts. Root-known checkpoint and different context ID required.

gate_boundary: Native gate determines readiness at response completion. It does not prove controller termination; root publishes handoff only afterward. No new model tool, method menu, or lifecycle registry.
